name: Seterra
description_short: Interactive map quizzes covering countries, capitals, flags, and geographic features — over 400 quizzes, playable instantly with no account needed.
teacher_note: Works well as a conversation driver with adult students too — have them explain their guesses out loud, not just click.
creator: Seterra
internal_notes: Verified live: free to play with no login required, sign-in optional. age_group set universal — the quiz format genuinely works for any age, from young learners to adults. cefr_level left unknown since it's a general-knowledge game, not a language-leveled resource, and language demand varies entirely by how the teacher uses it.
